sealed_results.all_output_oracle_interpretation: The frozen testbench compares every accepted output and fatals on any field mismatch; the sealed run reports 2,048 outputs and zero mismatches.

independent_oracle_reconstruction.method: independent 32-bit-masked xorshift32 and exact four-parent Hamming argmin with strict tie priority zero,left,up,previous
independent_oracle_reconstruction.independence_limit: The independent oracle regenerates the complete expected ledger and matches all sealed aggregate classes, but the producer does not log a per-output actual ledger; individual actual values therefore remain evidenced by the frozen VCS scoreboard and zero-mismatch terminal gate rather than a second file-level replay.

independent_elastic_schedule_reconstruct.method: cycle replay of the frozen two-stage ready equations, sustained-valid driver and fixed-seed ready generator
independent_elastic_schedule_reconstruct.throughput_interpretation: The two-stage selector sustains one accepted input and one accepted output on each cycle of a 126-cycle full-pipeline no-stall run. This is a block-interface throughput property, not accelerator cycles or speedup.

assertions: input payload remains valid and stable across input stall
output payload remains valid and stable across output stall
source count equals popcount(add OR subtract)
sva_and_cover_audit.judgment: The campaign closes the previous bubble-driver and count=256 gaps and gives strong directed elastic-interface evidence. It is not a formal protocol proof or constrained-random closure.

admitted: exact-SHA RTL VCS/SVA correctness for 2,048 deterministic sustained-valid transactions
one-descriptor-per-cycle steady-state block-interface behavior in a 126-cycle full-throughput run
all 2,048 output transactions checked by the frozen scoreboard with zero mismatch
count=256, all four parent classes, forced ties, 648 random output-stall cycles and 2,046 full-pipeline same-cycle push/pop events
not_admitted: M57-integrated cycles, FPS or system speedup
PPA, power, energy, accuracy or a DATE headline

P1.finding: The 2,048 transactions are deterministic synthetic vectors; M64 remains outside a sealed M57 all10 trace replay.
P1.impact: Block correctness and one-per-cycle interface throughput do not prove descriptor ordering, parent availability, integrated cycles or system speedup.
P1.minimal_fix: Insert M64 before M57 and replay every M53 all10 descriptor, receipting parent/tag/mask/count equality plus no drop, duplicate or reorder and per-sample cycle conservation.

P1.finding: The testbench supplies target plus three 256-bit parent operands without an address-timed seed-SRAM, banks, conflicts or latency.
P1.impact: The demonstrated selector throughput may be unfeedable or energetically unattractive in the real accelerator.
P1.minimal_fix: Bind the same handshake replay to a concrete banked seed-memory design and receipt three-parent availability, bytes, conflicts, stalls and macro energy per descriptor.

P1.finding: The run verifies frozen RTL only; it neither proves the r1c mapped netlist equivalent nor simulates post-synthesis timing behavior.
P1.impact: The strong RTL campaign cannot close the DC sequential-inversion/Formality requirement.
P1.minimal_fix: Run exact-SHA Formality with the sealed r1c SVF and, if needed, a mapped-netlist protocol smoke test using the same sustained vectors.

P1.finding: There is no real-trace cycle reduction, accuracy, traffic, selector-inclusive energy or equal-resource Fixed/RQTB/Prosperity/Phi-like baseline.
P1.impact: The result strengthens implementation credibility but does not increase the 48/100 novelty potential or establish an accelerator performance advantage.
P1.minimal_fix: Measure all10/full-network cycles, traffic, accuracy, area and PTPX energy with and without M64 under a common process, frequency, SRAM and scheduler model.

P2.finding: All outputs are checked internally, but the sealed log contains only aggregate counters and the terminal PASS, not a per-output actual ledger.
P2.minimal_fix: Emit and seal a compact tag,parent,count,add-hash,subtract-hash ledger so an independent validator can compare every observed transaction without trusting the testbench scoreboard alone.

P2.finding: Backpressure is one fixed xorshift seed and reset occurs only before traffic; there is no X injection, alternate seed or reset-while-full campaign.
P2.minimal_fix: Add several frozen seeds, long-stall bursts, ready toggles at occupancy boundaries, reset-while-full behavior and X/four-state checks, or discharge them formally.

P2.finding: SVA directly checks stall stability, mask conservation and stage-valid identity, but argmin/tie priority, tag ordering and no-drop/no-duplicate are enforced only by the procedural scoreboard.
P2.minimal_fix: Add transaction-history assertions or formal scoreboarding for accepted-tag order, conservation, exact argmin, invalid rejection and tie priority.

P2.finding: Frozen minima require only 32 back-to-back/full/push-pop events and one random stall, far below the sealed observations 1,561/126/2,046/648.
P2.minimal_fix: Raise the next frozen gate close to the independently reconstructed deterministic counts so major campaign regressions cannot still pass.

P2.finding: The 107-entry output manifest verifies the run but necessarily excludes itself and output_check.raw.log; RUN_COMPLETE pins the receipt, not the output-manifest SHA.
P2.minimal_fix: Publish the output-manifest SHA in an external handoff/parent receipt; this independent review currently supplies that root pin.

must_pass: M64-to-M57 all10 real-trace transaction and cycle replay
address-timed seed-SRAM three-parent bandwidth and macro cost
actual output ledger or formal transaction-conservation proof
selector-inclusive system speed, energy, area, accuracy and equal-resource baselines
